what: Product insight: PreToolUse hook only fires on Read, but the critical moment for recall is often before Edit. Agent can read a file, ignore the recall nudge, then edit freely with no second check. A PreToolUse hook on Edit that says "you have N memories for this file — did you recall before modifying?" would be harder to ignore. Also: large area_context memories that mention completion status in passing don't surface well — granular per-milestone completion memories would rank higher in recall relevance.
why: Discovered during a real failure: agent rewrote Cowork prompt including Vercel deployment as a task despite it being marked [x] complete in the same file AND mentioned in memories. The nudge fired multiple times on Read but was ignored. An Edit-time nudge would have been a stronger intervention point.
